transcript:
Speaker A: What business is your husband in?
Speaker B: He is... business... textile.
Speaker C: Mira, you look stunning! This saree is gorgeous. Where did you get it?
Speaker B: Yeh... Jaipur se. Husband ne.
Speaker C: Oh lovely! Jaipur has the best textiles. Do you travel often?
Speaker D: She's a bit jet-lagged from our Udaipur trip. [In Hindi to himself]: Udaipur gayi nahi thi, pati ne jhoot bola uske liye. [She hadn't gone to Udaipur, her husband lied for her.]
Speaker C: Mira, try the risotto. It's amazing here.
Speaker B: Haan, accha hai. [Yes, it is good.]
Speaker C: She's the quiet one in our group, but very sweet.
Speaker D: Dinner accha tha na? [Dinner was good, right?]
Speaker B: Haan. [Yes.]
Speaker D: Client ki wife bol rahi thi, "Your wife is beautiful." [The client's wife was saying, "Your wife is beautiful."]
Speaker B: Hmm.
Speaker B: Pati karodo kamata hai, diamonds le sakta hai, trips de sakta hai, par English nahi de sakta. Woh meri zimmedari hai. Sab kuch hai mere paas - paisa, kapde, gaadi. Par jab muh kholti hu, toh sab khatam. Ameer ghar ki bahu, par anpadh jaisi. [Husband earns crores, can buy diamonds, can give trips, but cannot give English. That is my responsibility. I have everything - money, clothes, car. But when I open my mouth, everything is finished. Daughter-in-law of a rich house, but like an illiterate.]
Speaker G: Mira phone uthati hai. English Seekho app download karti hai. Ek rupaye ka trial. General English show hello se baat shuru karein. Galat bolti hai, AI coach sudharti hai. 500 baar, kabhi judge nahi karti. [Mira picks up her phone. Downloads English Seekho app. One rupee trial. Start talking with General English show hello. She speaks incorrectly, the AI coach corrects her. 500 times, never judges.]
Speaker B: Itne saalon se kyun nahi kiya yeh? [Why didn't I do this for so many years?]
Speaker B: My name is Mira. I am from Jaipur. My husband is in the textile business. Hi, nice to meet you. I am Mira. We are based in Jaipur. My husband runs a textile company. I enjoy traveling and interior design.
Speaker G: Teen mahine baad, New Year party, wahi five-star hotel, wahi log. [Three months later, New Year party, same five-star hotel, same people.]
Speaker E: Mira, you look different today. Something has changed.
Speaker B: Thank you. I think I'm just more comfortable now. I have actually been learning English for the past few months. It's been such a beautiful journey.
Speaker E: Oh really? That's amazing! Your English is lovely.
Speaker B: I just practice 15 minutes daily, small videos, and an AI coach. It changed everything for me.
Speaker F: Your wife is not just beautiful, she's impressive.
Speaker D: Aaj tum sabse zyada shine kar rahi thi. [Today you were shining the most.]
Speaker B: English Seekho app. Roz 15 minute. Bas itna kiya. Agar meri jagah tum hoti, toh kya karti party mein? Chup khadi rehti ya bolti? English Seekho app download karo, ek rupaye ka trial hai. Paisa hai, time hai, excuse mat do. Agli party mein chup mat rehna, bolo confidently. Pati ka chehra dekhna tab. [English Seekho app. 15 minutes daily. That's all I did. If you were in my place, what would you do at the party? Stand quiet or speak? Download English Seekho app, there is a one rupee trial. You have money, you have time, don't give excuses. Don't stay quiet in the next party, speak confidently. See your husband's face then.]
Speaker G: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A wealthy but English-deficient woman feels embarrassed at social gatherings where her husband has to lie to cover for her silence. She downloads the English Seekho app, practices daily with its non-judgmental AI coach, and confidently speaks English at the next party. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app for a 1-rupee trial.
